purpose: Lesson-specific standalone RPH source records; not yet approved for public generation

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Present the picture story and recycle language from Friends.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Review pupils' names and ages through short teacher-pupil exchanges.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Review the four Super Friends, play the story, pause to identify characters and the cat, then replay frame by frame for pupils to listen and repeat.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: Use WB p8 to review story phrases and match each Super Friend to the correct power.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Use the verified story recording for SB pp8–9; WB p8 uses CD1 Track 11.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pause at key frames and ask pupils to identify who is speaking; check WB responses as a class.
lesson_plan.closure: Put pupils in groups of five to rehearse and perform the story roles.
lesson_plan.extension: Call out short phrases from the story and ask pupils to identify the speaker.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Discuss the story meaning, recycle unit language and help pupils reflect on learning.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Mime the Super Friends' powers and let pupils identify the character.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Replay the story with books closed, then have pairs read and number the pictures on SB p9; compare pair answers before whole-class checking.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: On WB p9 pupils draw and write examples showing what they know from the unit.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Replay the previously verified Friends story recording; no new exact track is introduced on this TB page.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare answers with another pair before class feedback.
lesson_plan.closure: Review numbers 1–10 using the Workbook picture dictionary in pairs.
lesson_plan.extension: Spell familiar unit words aloud and ask pupils to identify and locate the words.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Present and practise classroom objects and perform the unit chant.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Run a true/false colour review using objects around the classroom.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Present classroom-object flashcards, play the SB p10 recording for pupils to point and repeat, then use the chant first as a class and then in groups while pupils hold up relevant objects.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p10: match classroom-object words to pictures, then colour the objects as instructed.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p10 uses CD1 Tracks 12 and 13.
lesson_plan.assessment: Use pair pointing/naming practice, then check workbook matching and colours together.
lesson_plan.closure: Display flashcards around the room; call objects for pupils to point to, then reverse the task by pointing for pupils to name them.
lesson_plan.extension: Play a 2x2 classroom-object bingo/cross-out game.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise asking and answering about classroom objects using What's this? and Is it a ...?.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Display classroom-object flashcards with deliberately mismatched labels and let pupils correct them.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p11 listening to number the pictures, model the target questions and answers with real objects, replay for choral repetition, then run the guessing game in groups.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p11: listen and write the classroom-object words, then read statements and tick the correct box.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p11 uses CD1 Tracks 14 and 15; WB p11 uses CD1 Track 16.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pupils check listening answers in pairs before whole-class confirmation; repeat target exchanges aloud.
lesson_plan.closure: Slowly draw familiar items on the board while pupils guess using the target question pattern.
lesson_plan.extension: Use a hidden-object guessing game in pairs, with eyes closed instead of a blindfold if preferred.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Sing the classroom-object song and practise It's my / It isn't my language.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Flash classroom-object cards quickly and ask pupils to identify each item.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p12 song: identify desk objects, pre-teach 'in a mess', listen, repeat verse by verse and sing; then personalise the song with pupils' own classroom objects and complete the desk-matching task.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p12: follow the lines and build sentences using It's my / It isn't my.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p12 uses CD1 Track 17.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare desk-matching answers before class checking; elicit truthful It's my / It isn't my responses during the song game.
lesson_plan.closure: Sing the song again while substituting different classroom objects.
lesson_plan.extension: Practise spelling classroom-object words by completing missing letters in pairs.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Present and practise positive classroom imperatives and following instructions.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Show classroom objects one at a time; pupils write the words, compare spelling in pairs, then check as a class.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p13 pupils listen and choose the correct stickers, write the object words, mime the instructions, repeat the imperative forms, then play a chain game in small groups where each pupil follows and gives a new instruction.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p13: read and write classroom-object words, then read and match instructions/items by number.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p13 uses CD1 Tracks 19 and 20.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare sticker/listening choices, then check with the class; monitor the chain game for correct imperative use.
lesson_plan.closure: Play a 'Please' response game: pupils act only when the instruction includes please.
lesson_plan.extension: Invite pupils to lead the class by giving familiar imperative instructions.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Present the unit picture story and review classroom objects and imperatives.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Recall the Super Friends, their powers and the cat before revisiting the story context.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB pp14-15: identify characters and classroom objects, play the story, pause at key frames for comprehension, discuss helping each other, then replay for listen-and-repeat and role-play.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p14: listen and tick the matching story pictures, find Flash in the story, and match key phrases to numbers.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB story uses CD1 Track 21; WB p14 uses CD1 Track 22.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare before whole-class checking; pause at selected story frames to check comprehension.
lesson_plan.closure: Groups of seven take character roles, practise the story and perform it.
lesson_plan.extension: Give short story sequences in mixed order for pairs to reconstruct.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Discuss story meaning and practise the short vowel sound a.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Recycle polite/helping phrases from the story through a quick pass-the-object routine.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p15 replay and reread the story, find matching pictures and identify who says a target phrase; isolate the /a/ sound and practise the sound sentence at different speeds and volumes.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p15: identify the helping-each-other value, then write/match words containing the short a sound and listen/repeat.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p15 uses CD1 Track 23; WB p15 uses CD1 Track 24.
lesson_plan.assessment: Check matching answers as a class and compare sound/spelling responses with partners.
lesson_plan.closure: Dictate the sound sentence, compare versions in pairs, then run a spelling check with familiar short-a words.
lesson_plan.extension: Discuss why apologising and helping others matter, using pupils' own examples.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise listening/reading for specific information and present This is my desk / There's a ... .

lesson_plan.set_induction: Review classroom objects with a hidden drawing/guessing game using Is it a ...?.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p16 listen to five children describing desks, draw lines to match speakers/desks, compare in pairs and replay to check.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p16: read descriptions and mark each statement with a tick or cross.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p16 uses CD1 Track 25.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare listening matches before class checking; ask pupils to justify choices using visible desk objects.
lesson_plan.closure: Build an oral chain beginning This is my desk. There's a ... and add one object each turn.
lesson_plan.extension: Pupils draw their own desk and write a short description using the target pattern.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise integrated reading, speaking, writing and listening with classroom objects and imperatives.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Replay the Please imperative game and vary the classroom objects/instructions.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p17 read and choose the correct pictures, ask/answer in pairs, then draw a school bag and write a short modelled description.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p17: listen and number classroom objects according to the instructions.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: WB p17 uses CD1 Track 26.
lesson_plan.assessment: Check picture choices as a class; monitor pair questions and review written bag descriptions before final copying.
lesson_plan.closure: Volunteers show their bag pictures and read descriptions; classmates listen for how many items are mentioned.
lesson_plan.extension: Unscramble imperative phrases and reconstruct the correct word order.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Integrate Art through English and classify primary/secondary colours.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Create a colour mind map and elicit classroom objects associated with each colour.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p18 identify primary colours, discuss objects with those colours, then read about and predict how secondary colours are made before mixing/confirming.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p18: complete the primary/secondary colour chart, then read, write and colour using pupils' knowledge.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: No exact audio track is introduced on this Teacher's Book page.
lesson_plan.assessment: Groups share colour examples and discuss colour-mixing answers before class confirmation.
lesson_plan.closure: Pupils complete the reflection prompt Today I've learnt about... in their notebooks.
lesson_plan.extension: Create a colour wheel and label the colours.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Extend Art through English and complete a colour project.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Recall previous colour vocabulary and distinguish the primary colours.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p19 read and answer about colours, predict how white changes colours, then make a picture using primary/secondary colours and colour mixing.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p19: complete the colour-code picture.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: No exact audio track is introduced on this Teacher's Book page.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs discuss predictions, then compare results after mixing/colouring; review project language orally.
lesson_plan.closure: Complete a Today I've... reflection focused on colour learning and the finished picture.
lesson_plan.extension: Pupils create their own colour-code pictures and swap with a partner to solve.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop listening and acting through sequenced classroom instructions.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Review familiar imperatives by having pupils take turns giving simple instructions.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p20 listen and mime a sequence, listen again to number pictures, read and order story instructions, then practise giving/following instructions in pairs.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p20: follow the illustrated instructions to make a pencil holder.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p20 uses CD1 Track 27.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare sequencing answers before class checking; monitor whether instructions are followed in order.
lesson_plan.closure: Pairs write four instructions, exchange them and act out the partner's sequence.
lesson_plan.extension: Use the finished pencil holders for a pair instruction game about putting in and taking out classroom objects.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Review unit language, consolidate classroom objects/colours and reflect on learning.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Unscramble colour words in pairs.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p21 pairs make a poster, then use classmates' posters for a memory task about school objects and colours; review classroom-object vocabulary through the picture dictionary.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: WB p21: draw and write examples of what pupils know from the unit.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: No exact audio track is introduced on this Teacher's Book page.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs/groups compare posters and memory statements; review written/drawn learning examples.
lesson_plan.closure: Ask pupils for their favourite unit song, chant or game and repeat one with the class.
lesson_plan.extension: Groups share their WB p21 learning examples and compare what they have written and drawn.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Present toy vocabulary and practise listening, pointing and naming.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use the opening unit scene to identify toys, play the vocabulary recording for pupils to point and repeat, then recycle the words through short pair questions.
lesson_plan.assessment: Check recognition by pointing to different toys in random order and eliciting names.
lesson_plan.extension: Use real toys or picture cards for a quick memory/guessing game.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise toy vocabulary through a song and personal response.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use the unit song on SB p23: establish the scene, listen for toy words, replay for repetition and singing, then personalise with pupils' favourite toys.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pupils to identify the toy words heard and compare responses in pairs.
lesson_plan.extension: Groups substitute familiar toy words into the song pattern.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop listening discrimination and description of toys.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p24 listen and number the toy pictures, then use the monster/guessing task to practise describing and identifying items.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare numbering before replay/class checking; monitor descriptive exchanges.
lesson_plan.extension: Pupils draw a toy/monster and challenge a partner to identify it from a short description.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Follow the go-kart picture story and recycle unit language.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Preview the story pictures, elicit predictions, play/read the story, pause to check events and characters, then replay/read for sequence and role practice.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pupils to order key events and identify who says selected lines.
lesson_plan.closure: Groups take roles and perform a shortened version of the story.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Consolidate the story and practise key language from the go-kart episode.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Revisit the story, use the follow-up pictures/tasks to check understanding, then practise target phrases orally in pairs.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs justify answers using story evidence before whole-class feedback.
lesson_plan.extension: Retell the story using a small set of picture prompts.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop reading for specific information about toys.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Read the short toy descriptions on SB p27, number/match the go-karts and use the text to identify specific features.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pupils compare matches in pairs and point to the words that support each answer.
lesson_plan.extension: Write one new short toy description for a partner to match.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise reading and checking descriptions of familiar toys.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: On SB p28 look and read, then mark each statement true/false according to the pictures; follow with oral correction of false statements.
lesson_plan.assessment: Require pupils to correct each false sentence rather than only give a cross.
lesson_plan.extension: Pairs create one true and one false statement about another toy picture.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Integrate listening, speaking and writing around favourite toys.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Listen and write children's names under the correct toys, ask/answer about favourite toys, then draw and write a short description of a favourite toy.
lesson_plan.assessment: Compare listening answers in pairs; check that written descriptions correspond to pupils' drawings.
lesson_plan.extension: Display drawings and let classmates guess the toy from the description.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Integrate Mathematics/shape vocabulary through a tangram task.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Identify and name the shapes, read the short information about tangrams, identify missing shapes, then discuss how shapes combine to make pictures.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pupils to name both the shape and its position when checking.
lesson_plan.extension: Make a simple tangram picture and describe the shapes used.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Complete a hands-on tangram project using English instructions.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Follow the project sequence to make a tangram, use the pieces to create a picture and describe the result to a partner.
lesson_plan.assessment: Monitor pupils' ability to follow the sequence and name shapes while constructing.
lesson_plan.extension: Partners exchange tangram pictures and try to recreate each other's design.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Use imagination and oral language to create and present a picture.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Listen/imagine from the prompt, draw an individual picture, then show it to a partner and describe what was created.
lesson_plan.assessment: Partners listen for key unit vocabulary and ask a simple follow-up question.
lesson_plan.extension: Create a small class gallery and let pupils describe another pupil's picture.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Review Unit 2 language and reflect on learning.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use the final unit review/reflection activities to recycle toys, descriptions and shapes, then have pupils identify what they can now say/read/write.
lesson_plan.assessment: Use pair review followed by quick whole-class retrieval of unit vocabulary.
lesson_plan.closure: Pupils state or write one thing they learnt and one activity they enjoyed.
lesson_plan.extension: Repeat a favourite Unit 2 game using the verified vocabulary.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Introduce and practise pet vocabulary in the Unit 3 opening context.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Activate familiar animal words with picture/gesture recall.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use the opening scene to identify pets; model, listen, point and repeat the target words, then practise identification in pairs.
lesson_plan.assessment: Point to pets in mixed order and elicit names; pairs check one another.
lesson_plan.extension: Use pet picture cards for a quick memory/guessing round.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise pet vocabulary and unit language through the textbook activity.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Quickly recycle the pets introduced on the previous page.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Work through SB p35 using the pictures and target pet language; model the response pattern, practise chorally, then move to pair exchanges.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pairs to demonstrate one exchange and correct vocabulary/pronunciation as needed.
lesson_plan.extension: Pupils choose a pet and give one short clue for classmates to identify it.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop speaking using Unit 3 pet language.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Review pet names by showing or describing one animal at a time.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p36 as the speaking stimulus; model the textbook pattern, rehearse with the class, then conduct structured pair practice.
lesson_plan.assessment: Monitor whether pupils use the target form and pet word accurately.
lesson_plan.extension: Change partners and repeat with a different pet.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Consolidate Unit 3 language through the textbook follow-up task.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Retrieve key pet words without opening the book.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p37 pictures/text to complete the textbook task, compare answers in pairs, then reuse the language orally.
lesson_plan.assessment: Require pupils to point to visual/text evidence when checking answers.
lesson_plan.extension: Create one additional example using the same textbook language pattern.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Follow and understand the Unit 3 picture story.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Use the first story frame to predict characters, pets and what may happen.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Work through the SB pp38-39 story: listen/read, pause at key frames for comprehension, establish event order and replay/reread for repetition and role practice.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pupils to sequence key events and identify speakers/actions from the frames.
lesson_plan.closure: Assign story roles in small groups and perform a shortened retelling.
lesson_plan.extension: Retell the story from selected picture prompts.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Use the story follow-up to develop reading comprehension.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Recall the story events orally using three or four prompts.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Reread the relevant SB p39 section, complete the follow-up comprehension task and compare evidence in pairs.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pupils explain where in the story/picture they found each answer.
lesson_plan.extension: Pairs make one extra comprehension question about the story.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise Unit 3 language in a writing-focused textbook task.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Orally review the words/forms pupils will need before writing.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p40 as the writing model/stimulus; complete the guided task first, then produce a short individual response following the model.
lesson_plan.assessment: Use pair checking for target vocabulary and the modelled language pattern before class feedback.
lesson_plan.extension: Pupils add one additional sentence using verified Unit 3 vocabulary.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop writing and language consolidation using the Unit 3 textbook page.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Run a short oral retrieval of pet vocabulary.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Read/examine the SB p41 model, identify useful words or sentence frames, complete the guided task and then write independently at an appropriate Year 1 level.
lesson_plan.assessment: Partners compare work against the model and check key words.
lesson_plan.extension: Illustrate the written response and label the pet.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Practise speaking from the Unit 3 textbook stimulus.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Use picture prompts to reactivate the language needed for the task.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Model the SB p42 speaking exchange, practise as a class, then use pairs/small groups for repeated meaningful turns.
lesson_plan.assessment: Listen for correct target language and understandable pronunciation.
lesson_plan.extension: Turn the activity into a simple information-gap or guessing round.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop reading using the Unit 3 textbook material.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Preview the pictures/title and predict key words.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Read SB p43 for gist first, then reread for the information required by the textbook task; compare responses with a partner.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pupils to locate the word, phrase or picture clue supporting each response.
lesson_plan.extension: Match selected unit words to pictures or short meanings.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop listening using the Unit 3 textbook task.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Pre-listening review of the relevant pet vocabulary and pictures.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Study the SB p44 task before listening, listen once for the overall answer, then again for specific information; compare before whole-class checking.
lesson_plan.assessment: Replay only where needed and ask pupils what clue they heard.
lesson_plan.extension: Pairs reproduce a short oral version using the same vocabulary.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Revisit SB p42 as a reading-focused SOW lesson without changing its verified page mapping.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Recall the earlier speaking work from the same page.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Return to SB p42 and shift attention to reading/recognising the written language in the task; identify familiar words and complete the SOW-aligned reading focus.
lesson_plan.assessment: Check recognition by asking pupils to point to/read the relevant words or phrases.
lesson_plan.extension: Make a small word-picture matching set from the page.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Consolidate Unit 3 through the final textbook-linked writing task.

lesson_plan.set_induction: Review key Pet Show words and one favourite activity from the unit.
lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p45 to complete the final Unit 3 textbook task, support pupils with the page model, then allow an individual written response.
lesson_plan.assessment: Check completion against the page model and review common language points with the class.
lesson_plan.closure: Pupils share one thing they can now say/read/write about pets.
lesson_plan.extension: Repeat a favourite Pet Show vocabulary game.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Introduce and practise food vocabulary in the Unit 4 opening context.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p46 to establish the lunchtime scene, identify target food, listen/point/repeat and recycle the vocabulary through short oral identification.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Use verified SB p46 audio CD2 Tracks 02 and 03.
lesson_plan.assessment: Point to food items in random order and elicit names; use pair checking before class feedback.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop reading and speaking around Unit 4 food language.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p47 for the textbook reading/task, model the required response, allow pair comparison and then reuse the language orally.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: Use the verified WB activity linked to this page.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB p47 uses verified CD2 Track 04; WB uses verified CD2 Track 05.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pupils identify the textual/picture clue supporting each answer.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop listening and practise food language from the textbook.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Preview SB p48 pictures/food words, listen first for overall meaning and again for specific information, then practise the language through the page activity.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Use verified CD2 Tracks 06, 07 and 08.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare before replay and whole-class checking.
lesson_plan.extension: Adapt the page language into a short food preference chant or pair exchange.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop speaking using the Unit 4 textbook stimulus.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p49 to model the target exchange, practise chorally, then move to repeated pair speaking with different food items.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Use verified CD2 Tracks 09 and 10.
lesson_plan.assessment: Monitor target language and intelligible pronunciation; invite selected pairs to demonstrate.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Follow and understand the Unit 4 picture story.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Preview SB pp50-51, predict from pictures, listen/read the story, pause for comprehension and sequence, then replay/reread for role practice.
lesson_plan.activity_2_workbook: Use the verified story-linked Workbook task.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: SB story uses verified CD2 Track 11; WB uses verified CD2 Track 12.
lesson_plan.assessment: Ask pupils to order key events and identify speakers/actions using the story frames.
lesson_plan.closure: Groups rehearse and perform a shortened story retelling.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Consolidate the story and phonics/language follow-up on SB p51.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Return to SB p51 for the verified textbook follow-up; reread relevant story language and complete the page task before pair checking.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Verified phonics/follow-up audio: SB CD2 Track 13; WB CD2 Track 14.
lesson_plan.assessment: Check responses against the page and practise the target sound/language orally.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop listening and writing support through Unit 4 food language.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Preview SB p52, establish the task, listen for required information, replay for confirmation and use the results for a short supported response.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: Use verified CD2 Tracks 15 and 16.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pairs compare listening evidence before class confirmation.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop reading comprehension using the Unit 4 textbook page.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Read SB p53 first for gist and then for the specific information required by the textbook task; compare answers with a partner.
lesson_plan.activity_3_audio: No audio required in the current verified mapping.
lesson_plan.assessment: Pupils point to the word, phrase or picture evidence supporting each answer.

records.source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
records.aim: Develop speaking from the Unit 4 textbook stimulus.

lesson_plan.activity_1_student_book: Use SB p54 to establish the speaking context, model the target language and run structured pair/group exchanges.
